value.body: A power systems engineer plans and analyses how electricity is generated, transmitted and distributed. Power utilities, transmission companies, renewable-energy developers, EPC contractors and consultancies hire them. A day involves load-flow and protection studies, design reviews, site coordination and reporting on grid performance.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers enter as graduate engineer trainees at power utilities and EPC firms through campus placement, or through GATE scores for PSU recruitment and state electricity board exams. Training in a power-system simulation tool helps.

value.title: At a glance
items: GATE (Electrical) is a common route into PSU power-sector jobs.
Common next roles: senior engineer, protection specialist, grid planning or project manager.
Site postings at substations and plants are common early on.
